text: ماريك باروس سجل هدف رائع من مسافة بعيدة جداً حوالي 44 متر، ليضيف هدف ثاني لهاربور سيتي ويجعل النتيجة 2-0 ضد سيبروك تاون [#975]. الهدف جاء بعد هجمة منظمة بدأت بركلة ركنية وتحرك هادئ وتمرير واحد فقط استغرق 29 ثانية، مما يبين كيف أن الفريق يلعب بصبر وتركيز كبيرين [#971] [#972] [#973] [#975]. رغم أن سيبروك تاون كان يملك فرص واستحواذ جيد، إلا أن هاربور سيتي كان الأفضل في السيطرة والتمريرات الدقيقة، وهذا ظهر في الهدف الذي عزز تفوقهم على الملعب.

The sequence featured only one completed pass over 29 seconds involving four players, highlighting controlled possession leading into the chance [#moment, 971, 972].

- Marek Barros's assist via a cross and subsequent individual finish from long range (43.9m) illustrates Harbour City's ability to create scoring opportunities through precise delivery and intelligent movement from their attacking midfielders, fitting with the creative freedom and support roles typical in a 4-2-3-1 [#moment, 972, 975].

- Seabrook Town's 3-4-3 wide, crossing style did not manifest effectively here; they conceded a goal from open play despite their typical attacking width, underscoring Harbour City's disciplined defensive organization and possession control in the midfield to limit Seabrook's influence in this phase [#team_styles, #last_10_minutes].

- The fact that Harbour City extended their lead just after halftime by capitalizing on a set piece situation shows tactical preparation and mental focus from coach Tomasz Rhee’s team, enhancing their goal margin through patience and exploiting set piece delivery rather than open wide play or counter-attacking pressure [#moment, #team_styles].
